title: Simulating Misinformation Propagation in Social Networks using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning left-wing and right-wing political personas to LLM agents and measuring the factual degradation (Misinformation Index) of news articles propagating through these nodes using a QA-based auditor.
Conditioning LLM agents with a conservative religious leader persona and tracking the rate of factual drift and propaganda escalation across various news domains.

Simulating diverse social personas (e.g., young parents, lifestyle influencers, LGBTQ+ advocates, environmentalists) to evaluate how identity-driven motivated reasoning and confirmation bias amplify misinformation.

Measuring misinformation propagation rates across LLMs prompted with specific professional motives, such as sensationalist news agencies, conflict creators, brand collaborators, and medical experts, to see how role-specific heuristics alter factual fidelity.
